row.evidence: HireRight's pricing page only offers "Get a Customized Pricing Quote", and its client help articles (including the Super User guide covering Account Setup) require sign-in, so SCIM support cannot be checked publicly.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only background-screening vendor; no public plans. No SCIM or SSO-setup documentation is public: help.hireright.com client articles show only a summary and 'Sign In to Access All Help Articles', and the Connect API docs are not linked publicly. The marketing page for the HireRight Connect API says it supports managing users and accounts and SSO access to reports, but no endpoints are published. Okta OIN app is SWA (password vaulting) only; no Entra gallery tutorial (hireright-tutorial 404). Left unknown rather than none because the admin docs sit behind a login.

scim.notes: Not documented publicly; client help articles require sign-in.

limitations.text: Connect API marketing page says functionality covers 'background checks, users, and accounts'; no public endpoints.

user_api.notes: HireRight Connect API (background check, I-9, monitoring, accounts APIs) is described on a marketing page as supporting user and account management, but its reference is not public, so availability for customer user management is left null.

okta.notes: OIN app has only SWA checked (password vaulting).
